description:
This 2020 Toyota Corolla XSE combines practical reliability with modern comfort, offering a well-equipped sedan ready for daily driving and weekend adventures.

- All-Weather Floor Liners and cargo tray
- Audio Plus AM/FM/HD with Navigation and SiriusXM
- Apple CarPlay integration
- Automatic temperature control with rear window defroster
- Heated front sport seats with SofTex leather trim
- Power moonroof
- Exterior parking camera with rear view
- 18-inch machined alloy wheels
- Automatic headlights with delay-off feature
- Remote keyless entry with illuminated entry
- Heated power door mirrors
- Steering wheel mounted audio controls
- Electronic stability and traction control

The XSE trim prioritizes comfort and convenience with heated front sport seats dressed in SofTex leather, complemented by power windows, power steering, and a telescoping tilt steering wheel that adjusts to your preferred driving position. Climate control is handled by automatic temperature regulation, while the power moonroof adds openness and natural light to the cabin. The Exterior Parking Camera with rear view assists when backing up, and Apple CarPlay keeps you connected to your smartphone while maintaining focus on the road.

Performance-wise, this Corolla delivers responsive handling through its four-wheel independent suspension and front anti-roll bar, with confident stopping power from four-wheel disc brakes and ABS. The 2.0L four-cylinder engine paired with CVT transmission achieves strong fuel efficiency, returning 31 MPG in the city and 38 MPG on the highway—ideal for keeping fuel stops infrequent.

Safety stands as a cornerstone of this vehicle's design. Dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags provide comprehensive occupant protection. Additional features include electronic stability control, traction control, brake assist, and Toyota's Safety Connect emergency communication system with a three-year trial subscription. Low tire pressure warning and an occupant sensing system round out the protective equipment.

The Blueprint exterior finish presents a sophisticated appearance, while the body-color bumpers and turn signal indicator mirrors maintain visual coherence. Inside, the cabin offers practical storage with driver and passenger door bins, dual vanity mirrors, and front reading lights. A split folding rear seat provides flexibility for cargo accommodation, supported by the all-weather floor liner package that protects against water and dirt.

We invite you to visit our showroom and experience this Corolla firsthand. Our team is prepared to answer your questions and arrange a test drive at your convenience.

This 2020 Toyota Camry SE offers a balanced combination of reliability, efficiency, and practical features that appeal to drivers seeking a dependable sedan.

- ALL-WEATHER FLOOR LINER PACKAGE
- 8-Speed Automatic Transmission
- 2.5L I4 DOHC Engine
- 28 City / 39 Highway MPG
- Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
- SiriusXM Radio with AM/FM
- Automatic Temperature Control
- Power Driver Seat
- Remote Keyless Entry
- Rear Parking Camera
- Electronic Stability Control
- Sport Steering Wheel
- 18" Black Machined-Finish Alloy Wheels
- Dual Front Impact Airbags
- Toyota Safety Connect Emergency Communication System

The exterior presents a clean blue finish complemented by 18" black machined-finish alloy wheels and door edge guards that provide both style and protection. The rear bumper applique adds a refined touch to the vehicle's appearance. This Camry SE sits comfortably in the midrange of Toyota's sedan lineup, delivering the dependability Toyota owners expect.

Inside, the cabin focuses on comfort and convenience. Front sport bucket seats with fabric and SofTex trim provide adequate support for daily driving, while the split folding rear seat expands cargo flexibility. The leather shift knob, sport steering wheel, and telescoping tilt steering wheel give you control and adjust ability to suit your driving position. An overhead console and reading lights throughout contribute to an organized interior environment.

Technology integration meets modern expectations with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, allowing you to connect your smartphone seamlessly. The SiriusXM-equipped audio system pairs easily with steering wheel mounted controls, letting you manage entertainment without taking your hands off the wheel. The display provides outside temperature and trip computer information to keep you informed.

When it comes to efficiency, this Camry SE delivers 28 miles per gallon in the city and 39 on the highway, making it suitable for both commuting and longer drives. The eight-speed automatic transmission contributes to smooth acceleration and responsive handling. Front-wheel drive provides predictable traction in various weather conditions.

Safety systems include Electronic Stability Control, four-wheel independent suspension with front and rear anti-roll bars, and speed-sensing steering that adjusts to road conditions. Multiple airbags surround occupants, including dual front impact, dual front side impact, knee, and overhead airbags. The rear parking camera helps you navigate tight spaces with confidence, and low tire pressure warnings keep you aware of maintenance needs. Toyota's Safety Connect emergency communication system comes with a one-year trial.

The I4 hybrid engine paired with the eCVT transmission provides a smooth, efficient driving experience that reduces trips to the pump while maintaining responsive acceleration when you need it. The white exterior with white platinum metallic tri-coat finish presents a clean, sophisticated appearance that works well in any setting.

The Titanium trim brings genuine leather sport bucket seats with heating and cooling functions, ensuring comfort during both warm summer drives and chilly winter months. The heated steering wheel adds another layer of comfort, while the power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light and fresh air. Premium appointments include an overhead console, trip computer, and illuminated entry lighting that combines practicality with refinement.

Technology integration is comprehensive with SYNC 3 at the center of the infotainment experience, offering intuitive voice control and smartphone integration. The navigation system helps you reach your destination with confidence, while the SiriusXM radio with 12 speakers provides excellent audio quality for your favorite programs. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls allow you to stay focused on the road while managing entertainment options.

Safety receives appropriate attention with electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel independent suspension, and a complete airbag system including dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags. ABS brakes with brake assist provide stopping confidence, while the low tire pressure warning keeps you informed about tire condition. The rear parking camera adds an extra layer of awareness when maneuvering in tight spaces.

Convenience features throughout the cabin make daily driving effortless. Remote keyless entry, speed control, power windows, power steering, and telescoping tilt steering wheel adjust to your preferences. The split folding rear seat provides flexibility for cargo or passengers, while the front center armrest with storage adds practical utility.

This 2020 Volkswagen Jetta 1.4T SE in Blue combines practical performance with thoughtful interior appointments, offering you a reliable sedan that delivers both everyday utility and driving satisfaction.

- 1.4L TSI turbocharged engine with 8-speed automatic transmission
- VW App-Connect with Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and MirrorLink
- 6.5" touchscreen radio system with AM/FM and radio data system
- Heated front comfort seats with perforated V-Tex leatherette trim
- Power moonroof
- SE Cold Weather Package with heated steering wheel and rear window defroster
- Exterior parking camera rear
- Automatic and fully automatic headlights with delay-off feature
- Heated power door mirrors with integrated controls
- Front dual zone automatic temperature control
- Remote keyless entry with illuminated entry
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS and brake assist
- Dual front impact and side impact airbags with occupant sensing
- Alloy wheels with 16" 2-tone machined design
- Variably intermittent wipers

With 30 city and 40 highway MPG, this Jetta provides excellent fuel efficiency for both your commute and longer drives. The 1.4L TSI turbocharged engine pairs responsive acceleration with manageable fuel consumption, making it an economical choice without sacrificing performance. At 53,347 miles, this vehicle has been well-maintained and operates like a much newer model.

The interior reflects Volkswagen's commitment to driver-focused design. Heated front comfort seats wrapped in perforated V-Tex leatherette provide warmth and support, while the heated steering wheel adds another layer of comfort during colder months. The front center armrest and split folding rear seats offer flexibility for passengers and cargo, and the overhead console keeps essentials within reach.

Technology integration is seamless with VW App-Connect, giving you access to Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and MirrorLink through the 6.5" touchscreen. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your hands where they belong while driving. The trip computer and outside temperature display provide useful information at a glance, and the roadside assistance kit ensures added peace of mind when you need it.

Safety features are comprehensive, including Electronic Stability Control, Traction Control, brake assist, and a full complement of airbags. The exterior parking camera rear helps with maneuvering in tight spaces, while the low tire pressure warning system helps maintain optimal vehicle performance.

We invite you to schedule a test drive and see how this Jetta handles on the road. Our team is ready to answer your questions and help you find the right fit for your transportation needs.

Is the 2020 Dodge Charger GT a good buy?

What is AutoStick on the Dodge Charger?

Collision Mitigation Braking System with forward collision warning helps prevent accidents before they occur, while lane departure warning alerts you if unintended lane drift is detected. The comprehensive airbag system includes dual front, dual front side, knee, and overhead airbags. Electronic stability control and four-wheel independent suspension work together to maintain stable handling in various driving situations.

Entertainment and connectivity features keep you connected on the road. The 180-watt AM/FM audio system with eight speakers delivers clear sound quality, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration allows seamless smartphone connection for navigation, messaging, and music streaming. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls enable safe operation without taking your hands off the wheel.

Practical conveniences include auto high-beam headlights that adjust automatically to oncoming traffic, front fog lights for improved visibility in adverse weather, and speed-sensitive wipers that adjust based on vehicle speed. The exterior parking camera provides a clear view when reversing, reducing the stress of backing into tight spaces. The trip computer displays fuel efficiency and other useful driving data.

This 2020 Honda Accord Sport offers the balance of technology, comfort, and reliability that makes it a compelling choice in the midsize sedan segment. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this vehicle firsthand.

2020 Genesis G70 3.3T Premium Pre-Owned

There is something particularly appealing about a sport sedan that refuses to choose between performance and everyday comfort. This 2020 Genesis G70 3.3T delivers exactly that balance, pairing a potent twin-turbocharged V6 with a beautifully finished cabin and the composed road manners expected from a modern luxury sedan. With 83,015 miles, it also represents an opportunity to experience genuine luxury and performance at a fraction of the cost of buying new.

The heart of the G70 is its 3.3-liter twin-turbocharged V6, producing 365 horsepower and 376 lb-ft of torque. Power is delivered through an 8-speed automatic transmission, and the G70's performance-oriented chassis gives it the kind of responsive character that makes a routine commute considerably more enjoyable.

This is a sedan designed for drivers who appreciate the details. The G70 combines athletic proportions with a sophisticated interior, creating an environment that feels equally appropriate for arriving at the office, heading out for dinner or settling in for a longer Texas highway drive. Its relatively compact dimensions make it easy to maneuver in town, while its independent suspension and carefully tuned chassis provide a planted, confident feel at highway speeds.

Inside, the G70 3.3T emphasizes comfort without becoming excessive. Leather seating, heated front seats, a power-adjustable driver's seat with memory, dual-zone automatic climate control and a leather-wrapped steering wheel give the cabin a distinctly upscale character. The available equipment on the 3.3T platform also includes conveniences such as Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Bluetooth connectivity and an available premium Lexicon audio system, depending on configuration.

For buyers who enjoy their music as much as their driving, the G70's available Lexicon system is especially noteworthy. The premium configuration incorporates 15 speakers, two subwoofers and a dedicated amplifier, while the available navigation and smartphone integration help keep modern connectivity within easy reach.

Safety and driver awareness are also important parts of the G70 experience. The 2020 G70 incorporates technologies including blind-spot monitoring, lane-departure warning, lane-keeping assistance, forward collision mitigation and rear cross-traffic awareness depending on configuration.

Premium Pre-Owned Confidence from Infiniti of Boerne

At 83,015 miles, this G70 deserves more than a quick cosmetic cleanup before being offered for sale. As a Premium Pre-Owned vehicle at Infiniti of Boerne, it is inspected by experienced INFINITI and ASE Certified Technicians and evaluated against our internal reconditioning standards.

Any reconditioning needs identified during that process are addressed as appropriate so the vehicle can be presented in excellent mechanical and cosmetic condition. The vehicle is also professionally detailed before delivery.

That process matters. When purchasing a used luxury vehicle, shoppers are not simply evaluating the leather, technology or performance they can see in the showroom. They are also buying into the condition of the vehicle and the confidence they have in the preparation behind it. Our Premium Pre-Owned process is designed to provide that additional level of confidence without suggesting manufacturer certification or factory-backed coverage that has not been verified for this particular vehicle.

Why the G70 3.3T Makes Sense

The G70 3.3T occupies a compelling position in the luxury sedan market. It offers serious performance without requiring the compromises often associated with a dedicated sports car. Its 365-horsepower V6 provides effortless acceleration, while the cabin remains comfortable and refined enough for everyday driving.

For a luxury commuter, executive or driving enthusiast, that combination is difficult to overlook. You get the presence and craftsmanship of a premium sedan, the performance of a sport-oriented car and the practicality of a four-door cabin—all without stepping into the price range of a comparable new luxury vehicle.

For Texas buyers, the G70 is particularly well suited to the mix of city driving and open highway that defines so much of the region. Whether your daily route takes you through San Antonio or your travels extend toward Austin, Houston, Corpus Christi, the Rio Grande Valley or Dallas–Fort Worth, the G70's combination of performance and comfort makes it an appealing long-distance companion.

Why Buy Premium Pre-Owned at Infiniti of Boerne?

Your purchase experience matters just as much as the vehicle itself. Infiniti of Boerne is located directly off Interstate 10 and is an easy drive north of San Antonio, making it convenient for shoppers throughout the Texas Hill Country and beyond.

Our dealership has been recognized as a 2026 J.D. Power Dealer of Excellence, and we were the first INFINITI retailer in Texas designated as a J.D. Power Dealer of Excellence. We have also earned the INFINITI Award of Excellence five times, including 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021 and 2025.

For customers who cannot make the trip to Boerne, the purchasing experience can extend beyond the showroom. Complete online purchasing is available, and complimentary home delivery is available for Premium Pre-Owned vehicle purchases. Out-of-town buyers can also arrange complimentary airport pickup from San Antonio International Airport.

The result is a different kind of used-car experience: a thoughtfully selected luxury vehicle, professionally inspected and reconditioned by experienced technicians, presented by a dealership committed to making the ownership experience as comfortable and straightforward as the vehicle itself.

If you have been searching for a Premium Pre-Owned Luxury Vehicle, a performance-oriented sedan or a distinctive alternative in the Luxury Sedan Texas market, this 2020 Genesis G70 3.3T deserves a closer look. Schedule a personalized test drive at Infiniti of Boerne and experience the balance of performance, refinement and value that makes the G70 such an intriguing luxury sedan.

This 2020 Tesla Model 3 Long Range delivers exceptional efficiency and advanced technology in a refined electric vehicle designed for modern driving.

- 15 Speakers with Premium Audio System
- Navigation System
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- All-Wheel Drive with 1-Speed Automatic
- Electric Motor

- Heated Rear Seats

The electric powertrain delivers impressive efficiency throughout daily driving, achieving 124 MPGe in the city and 116 MPGe on the highway. All-Wheel Drive provides confident traction and stability across varied road conditions, while the responsive electric motor offers smooth acceleration and refined performance without the complexity of a traditional transmission.

The interior combines comfort with technology, featuring premium heated front bucket seats with power adjustment and memory settings. Dual-zone automatic climate control maintains personalized comfort for driver and passenger, with additional heating for the rear seats during colder months. The steering wheel includes memory settings and mounted controls for audio and climate functions, allowing you to manage key features without taking your hands off the wheel.

Safety features are comprehensive, including dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. The 4-wheel disc brake system with ABS, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to provide reliable stopping power and vehicle stability. A rearview parking camera assists with maneuvering and reversing with confidence.

The exterior showcases 18-inch aero wheels, body-color bumpers, and heated power-adjustable door mirrors. Auto high-beam headlights with delay-off functionality enhance visibility and safety, while front fog lights improve sight lines in challenging weather. The blue finish presents a striking appearance while maintaining the vehicle's streamlined aesthetic.

Interior conveniences include a premium navigation system for seamless route planning, a 15-speaker audio system with radio data capability, and a comprehensive trip computer displaying real-time efficiency metrics. Heated front seats, a rear seat center armrest, and split-folding rear seats accommodate passengers and cargo flexibly. Premium seat trim and genuine wood dashboard inserts create an upscale atmosphere throughout the cabin.

This Model 3 Long Range represents a practical choice for drivers seeking reliable, efficient transportation with modern technology and comfort features. We invite you to visit our showroom to explore this vehicle in detail and arrange a test drive.

This 2016 Mercedes-Benz S-Class S 550 represents the pinnacle of luxury sedan engineering, offering refined performance and sophisticated design for the discerning driver.

- 4.7L V8 BiTurbo engine with 7-speed automatic transmission
- COMAND® navigation system with premium audio and SiriusXM
- Panoramic power moonroof
- Leather upholstery with heated and ventilated front seats
- Adaptive and auto-leveling suspension systems
- Backup camera with exterior parking camera
- Bluetooth connectivity with hands-free calling
- Memory seat and steering wheel settings

The exterior silver finish presents a timeless elegance that complements the S-Class's commanding presence. The 4.7L V8 BiTurbo engine delivers capable performance while the seven-speed automatic transmission ensures smooth acceleration and responsive handling across all driving conditions. This rear-wheel-drive configuration provides the dynamic control expected from Mercedes-Benz's flagship sedan.

Inside, the cabin welcomes you with premium leather upholstery, heated and ventilated front seats that adjust to your preferred position through memory settings. The panoramic moonroof floods the interior with natural light, while the burl walnut wood trim adds warmth and sophistication to every surface. Genuine wood accents on the console and door panels reinforce the meticulous attention to detail found throughout.

The COMAND® navigation system integrates seamlessly with premium audio featuring thirteen speakers and SiriusXM radio capability. Bluetooth connectivity enables hands-free phone calls, keeping you connected while maintaining focus on the road. The backup camera assists during reversing, complemented by the exterior parking camera for enhanced awareness.

Adaptive suspension technology automatically adjusts to road conditions, while auto-leveling ensures consistent ride height regardless of load. Speed-sensing steering and electronic stability control work in concert to provide confident handling in various driving scenarios. Dual-zone automatic climate control with memory settings maintains your preferred cabin temperature.

The S-Class S 550 combines luxury appointments with substantive engineering. With highway fuel economy of 26 mpg and city performance of 17 mpg, this sedan balances power with practical efficiency. The comprehensive airbag system, including knee and overhead protection, demonstrates Mercedes-Benz's commitment to occupant safety.

This well-maintained S 550 awaits your inspection. Visit our showroom to experience the commanding presence, refined comfort, and prestigious heritage that define the Mercedes-Benz S-Class.

This 2016 Toyota Corolla L offers a straightforward, dependable driving experience that meets the needs of buyers seeking value and reliability in a compact sedan.

- 1.8L I4 DOHC Dual VVT-i engine with 4-Speed Automatic transmission
- 27 city / 36 highway MPG
- 6.1" Touch Screen with AM/FM/CD Player and 6 speakers
- Steering wheel mounted audio controls
- Air conditioning with rear window defroster
- Power windows and power door mirrors
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Dual front impact airbags and dual front side impact airbags
- Knee airbag and overhead airbag
- ABS brakes with Brake Assist
- Front bucket seats with split folding rear seat
- Telescoping and tilt steering wheel
- Trip computer and outside temperature display

The exterior presents a clean black finish that maintains a professional appearance. Inside, the fabric seat trim and front center armrest with storage provide comfort for daily commutes and longer drives. The cabin layout prioritizes functionality, with illuminated entry, reading lights, and a driver vanity mirror for convenience.

Engine performance is handled by a 1.8L I4 DOHC Dual VVT-i paired with a 4-Speed Automatic transmission, delivering consistent fuel efficiency at 27 MPG city and 36 MPG highway. This powertrain achieves the balance many drivers expect from an economy sedan, whether navigating city streets or highway routes.

Safety features are comprehensive and integrated throughout the vehicle. The Electronic Stability Control, Traction Control, and ABS brakes work together to enhance control in various driving conditions. The airbag system includes dual front impact, dual front side impact, knee, and overhead airbags to protect occupants. Speed-sensing steering and front anti-roll bar technology contribute to responsive handling and stability.

The interior technology focuses on straightforward usability. The 6.1" touch screen interface provides access to AM/FM radio and CD player functions, while steering wheel mounted audio controls allow you to adjust settings without taking your hands from the wheel. The trip computer and outside temperature display offer practical information for your journey.

This Corolla L presents itself as a practical choice for buyers who value efficiency, safety, and everyday reliability. We encourage you to schedule a time to view this vehicle and confirm it meets your expectations.

This Camry SE represents a practical choice for drivers seeking Toyota dependability with straightforward features and solid build quality.

ONE KENNEWICK FAMILY, NEARLY NINE YEARS, AND UNDER TWO THOUSAND MILES A YEAR

Somebody in Kennewick bought this Impala in October 2017 and kept it until this month. Almost nine years. In that time they put on about 1,972 miles a year, which is the kind of number you see on a car that goes to church, to the store, and to Walla Walla twice a summer. Then it got parked in a garage. That is why a 2017 full-size sedan is sitting here with 40,694 miles on it.

You open the door on the perforated leather, drop into an eight-way power seat with power lumbar, and shut a door that closes like a car from a segment above this one. The 3.6L V6 does the rest quietly.

THE VEHICLE

2017 Chevrolet Impala Premier 2LZ in Silver Ice Metallic over Jet Black perforated leather. 40,694 miles. 3.6L V6 direct injection DOHC, six-speed automatic with overdrive, front wheel drive, four door sedan. Premier is the top trim, and 2LZ is the top equipment group within it.

ARCHIBALD CERTIFIED

This Impala passed our 100-point inspection and is backed by our 3 Month/3,000 Mile Limited Warranty covering engine, transmission and transfer case, and differential components.

HOW IT IS EQUIPPED

Preferred Equipment Group 2LZ. Perforated leather-appointed seat trim with heated driver and front passenger seats. Eight-way power driver and eight-way power front passenger seats, both with power lumbar. Front bucket seats with a center armrest and a split folding rear seat.

Chevrolet MyLink premium audio with an 8 inch diagonal color infotainment display, Apple CarPlay, a 100-watt six speaker system, SiriusXM satellite radio, three USB ports and a remote CD player. Front dual zone automatic climate control with rear window defroster. Compass, tachometer, trip computer, overhead console, leather shift knob, illuminated entry, front and rear reading lights.

Outside: heated power door mirrors with turn signal indicators, bodyside moldings, body-color bumpers and alloy wheels. Four wheel independent suspension, four wheel disc brakes with ABS and brake assist, traction control, and OnStar emergency communication. Front and rear premium all-weather floor mats.

THE CARFAX

No accidents or damage reported. No structural damage, no airbag deployment, no total loss, no odometer rollback, every title brand guaranteed clean. No open recalls reported to CARFAX.

Service was handled by Chevrolet dealers: McCurley Chevrolet in Pasco ran maintenance inspections in December 2017 and February 2018 covering brakes, drive belts, lights, steering and suspension and an oil leak check. Sherrell Chevrolet in Hermiston did oil and filter with tire rotation at 30,417 and again at 35,314. Most recently 360 Automotive in Kennewick did oil and filter, checked the battery and charging system and replaced headlight bulbs at 40,026 miles.

THE HONEST PART

The factory warranty has expired. That is what our certification and Limited Warranty are for. The odometer reads 40,694 miles.

Big comfortable sedans like this are getting hard to find, and low-mileage ones with a local history are harder still. Come sit in it.

A negotiable documentary service fee of $200.00 may apply to each purchase.

The interior features MB-Tex leatherette seat trim on front bucket seats with a center armrest for added refinement. The split-folding rear seat provides flexibility for passengers or cargo. This 2017 Honda Civic Si in striking red is a well-maintained sports sedan that delivers engaging performance with practical everyday functionality.

- Clean Carfax
- 1.5L Turbocharged I-4 Engine with 6-Speed Manual Transmission
- 450-Watt AM/FM/HD/SiriusXM Audio System with 10 Speakers
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration
- Power Moonroof
- 18" Gloss Black Machine-Finished Alloy Wheels
- Reclining Heated Front Bucket Seats
- Rear Backup Camera
- Automatic Temperature Control with Dual Front and Rear Window Defroster
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Speed-Sensitive Steering
- Leather Shift Knob
- Emergency Communication System
- Speed-Sensitive Wipers

The turbocharged four-cylinder engine balances efficiency and spirited driving dynamics, achieving 28 mpg in the city and 38 mpg on the highway. The responsive six-speed manual transmission puts you in complete control, making every drive engaging while keeping fuel consumption reasonable for a performance-oriented compact sedan.

The Si cabin combines sport and comfort with heated front bucket seats and a rear seat center armrest for passenger accommodation. You'll appreciate the modern conveniences including the 450-watt audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio, plus seamless smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility. The power moonroof adds an open-air feel when you want it.

Safety and handling are core to this vehicle's design. Four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensitive steering provides responsive control, while electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist work together to maintain confidence in varying conditions. The rear backup camera assists with parking precision, and comprehensive airbag coverage protects all occupants.

The exterior features fog lights, heated power mirrors, automatic headlights with delay-off functionality, and a distinctive spoiler that marks this as a serious driving machine. The alloy wheels are finished in gloss black with a machine accent, complementing the vibrant red paint.

With under 76,000 miles on the odometer and a clean Carfax history, this Civic Si represents solid value for someone seeking an affordable, engaging manual sports sedan that doesn't compromise on features or reliability.

- Heated front seats

The S90 T5 combines performance with efficiency, powered by a turbocharged 2.0L four-cylinder engine that delivers 23 mpg city and 34 mpg highway. All-wheel drive provides confident handling in various conditions, while the eight-speed automatic transmission with Geartronic shifts smoothly whether you're navigating city streets or cruising the highway. This single-owner vehicle shows 66,464 miles and comes with a clean Carfax report.

The interior reflects Volvo's commitment to quality and comfort. Premium leather upholstery paired with genuine wood trim creates a sophisticated cabin environment. Heated front seats with power adjustment ensure personalized comfort, while the four-zone climate control allows each passenger their preferred temperature. The digital instrument cluster provides clear, customizable information, and Apple CarPlay integration keeps you connected safely.

Technology features enhance both convenience and safety. Park Assist Pilot helps with parking maneuvers, while the backup camera provides rear visibility. Active Bending Lights adapt to your steering input, and auto high-beam functionality adjusts lighting automatically. HomeLink allows remote garage door operation, and the power trunk lid adds practicality to everyday use.

Safety systems include electronic stability control, lane departure warning, and a comprehensive airbag system. The independent four-wheel suspension absorbs road imperfections, while speed-sensing steering adapts to your driving conditions. Dual-zone air conditioning in front and full rear air conditioning keep all passengers comfortable.

This Momentum Plus equipped S90 T5 represents a well-appointed sedan ready for your ownership. The combination of Volvo reliability, practical luxury features, and proven efficiency makes this an excellent choice for the discerning buyer. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience the quality and refinement this vehicle offers.

The 2015 Mercedes-Benz S-Class S 550 immediately impresses with its blend of silk-smooth composure and tactile driver engagement. Behind the wheel, you experience a sedan that feels planted and confident, with the kind of precise steering and nuanced chassis tuning that invites you to enjoy every curve and merge.

Drivers who notice subtle differences in steering feedback, throttle response, and chassis balance will appreciate what this sedan brings to the table. If your daily drive includes highways and urban traffic in places like Lakeland, FL, the S 550’s adaptive suspension and meticulous isolation from noise transform even routine errands into a pleasure. Enthusiasts who value both refinement and genuine connection to the road will find themselves looking for reasons to stay behind the wheel.

Performance in the S 550 centers around a 4.7L V8 BiTurbo engine paired with a seamless automatic transmission and rear-wheel drive. The throttle responds briskly, offering an immediate surge of power that feels both effortless and controlled. Shifts are nearly imperceptible, but the transmission’s logic keeps the engine in its sweet spot, providing confident acceleration for passing and merging. The speed-sensing steering delivers natural weight and crisp feedback—never artificial—while the adaptive suspension keeps body motions taut yet compliant, so the car settles quickly after bumps and remains composed through sweepers. Brake pedal feel is progressive, instilling confidence whether rolling to a stoplight or making more spirited decelerations.

Safety systems in the S 550 enhance driver confidence without diminishing involvement. Electronic Stability Control steps in discreetly, supporting composure on slick surfaces or during sudden maneuvers. The suite includes ABS brakes and traction control, which work together to maintain grip and stability. Features like the rear parking camera and rain-sensing wipers deliver practical assistance, while lane management and emergency communication systems offer reassurance without intruding on the hands-on driving experience. The net effect is a sedan that feels secure and controlled, complementing its dynamic abilities.

This S-Class is appointed with features designed to elevate comfort and engagement. Heated Power Front Seats with memory settings ensure an ideal driving position, while the COMAND® System with AM/FM/GPS Navigation and premium audio keeps you connected and entertained. Automatic climate control, dual zone A/C, and a rear window blind create a tranquil environment for every occupant.

When compared with competitors like the BMW 7 Series and Audi A8, the S 550 stands out for its uniquely balanced driving dynamics and cabin serenity. While others may emphasize technology or outright sportiness, this sedan excels in delivering a harmonious blend of comfort, road feel, and refinement.

Is the S 550 engaging to drive? Absolutely—the steering, throttle, and suspension all communicate with the driver, making every trip rewarding. How refined is the cabin? With its exclusive Nappa leather, insulated glass, and attention to detail, the interior remains serene in nearly any setting.

Lakeland Automall invites you to experience the uniquely rewarding drive of the 2015 Mercedes-Benz S-Class S 550 in person. For details or to schedule a test drive, call (863) 577-5030 or visit 1430 W Memorial Blvd, Lakeland, FL 33815. Discover how every day can feel exceptional behind the wheel.

description: This 2015 Lexus IS 250 F Sport is exactly the kind of IS we love finding. It was California-owned its entire life and comes in the absolutely stunning Matador Red Mica exterior over black leather, a color combination that perfectly fits the aggressive personality of the F Sport. This one has the must-have F Sport Package, Navigation Package, rearview camera with dynamic gridlines, F Sport digital gauge cluster, F Sport sport seats, upgraded suspension, F Sport steering wheel, and exclusive F Sport wheels. The Matador Red Mica has an incredible depth and metallic finish in direct sunlight, and paired with the black interior and aggressive F Sport bodywork, this car still looks incredibly modern more than a decade later.The F Sport Package is absolutely everything to us on an IS because it transforms the entire car. You get the more aggressive F Sport front bumper and signature spindle grille, sportier side skirts, upgraded rear bumper and rear treatment, exclusive F Sport wheels, sport-tuned suspension, upgraded steering feel and components, F Sport steering wheel, upgraded sport seats, aluminum sport-inspired interior details, and F Sport logos throughout the interior and exterior. Park an F Sport next to a standard IS 250 and they almost look like two different cars. The F Sport has a lower, wider, more aggressive appearance, and from behind the wheel it feels considerably more connected and performance-oriented.One of our absolute favorite parts of the F Sport Package is the F Sport digital instrument cluster. This completely blows the basic IS gauge cluster out of the water. The standard cluster has a much more traditional analog appearance that, in our opinion, can make the interior look like something from the mid-2000s. The F Sport digital display and signature movable center gauge completely transform the driver's cockpit and still look like something you could find in a 2026 model-year performance car. It's one of those options you appreciate every single time you start the vehicle.The Matador Red Mica exterior is another huge part of what makes this one special. This isn't a flat bright red—the metallic finish gives the paint tremendous depth, changing character depending on the lighting. In the shade it has a deeper, richer appearance, while direct sunlight brings the metallic flake to life. Against the black leather F Sport interior, dark grille, aggressive bodywork, and F Sport wheels, it's an incredible combination.Inside, the F Sport seats are a substantial upgrade from what you get in a basic IS. The additional bolstering holds you in place when you're actually enjoying the car through corners while remaining extremely comfortable for everyday driving and longer trips. Combine them with the F Sport steering wheel, sport-inspired interior trim, aluminum details, black interior, and digital gauge cluster, and the entire cabin feels much more like a dedicated luxury sport sedan than an ordinary IS 250.The Navigation Package is another important option on this particular car. You get the factory Lexus navigation system integrated directly into the dashboard along with the rear backup camera and dynamic gridlines. Those dynamic guidelines move with your steering input to help show where the vehicle is heading while you're backing into a parking space, making the system substantially more useful than a basic fixed-line camera.Under the hood is Lexus' smooth and proven 2.5-liter V6, delivering the naturally aspirated response and refinement that helped build the IS reputation. There is no tiny turbocharger trying to make up for displacement—the power delivery is smooth and predictable, with the refined character Lexus does so well. It's an excellent combination for someone who wants the styling and handling personality of the F Sport while maintaining the comfort and long-term ownership characteristics that made Lexus famous.You also get the everyday luxury features that make the IS such a great car to live with, including power front seats, dual-zone automatic climate control, SmartAccess keyless entry with push-button start, Bluetooth connectivity, steering-wheel audio controls, cruise control, premium interior materials, LED exterior lighting, and Lexus' exceptionally quiet and refined cabin. This is a car that's enjoyable when you're pushing it through a back road but equally comfortable sitting in traffic every day.The California ownership history is another major reason we like this particular IS. When we're buying older luxury and performance vehicles, where a car spent its life matters to us. Combine that West Coast history with the condition, equipment, and rare color combination, and this is exactly the type of IS we want representing Supreme Motors.Put everything together—the F Sport Package, Matador Red Mica over black leather, aggressive F Sport bodywork, upgraded suspension and steering, F Sport wheels, F Sport steering wheel and sport seats, incredible digital gauge cluster, Navigation Package, backup camera with dynamic gridlines, and California ownership history—and this is one seriously good-looking 2015 Lexus IS 250 F Sport. If you're shopping these cars, don't just compare mileage and price. Compare the package, the gauge cluster, the color combination, the equipment, and the history. The right F Sport is an entirely different car. 2015 INFINITI Q50 Performance and Engine

The 3.7-Liter V6 A Proven Powerplant

If you've been driving front-wheel-drive sedans and want something that feels genuinely engaging, the Q50 3.7 RWD is a substantial step up.

INFINITI Q50 Features and Interior

What the Premium Trim Brings

The 3.7 Premium trim steps up from base with features like a dual-screen infotainment setup, INFINITI's InTouch technology, Bose audio system, heated front seats, dual-zone automatic climate control, and a sunroof. The cabin uses quality materials throughout genuine leather seating, soft-touch surfaces, and thoughtful ergonomics that make long drives comfortable.

INFINITI Q50 Reliability and Ownership

The Q50 3.7 particularly the naturally aspirated V6 variant has earned a strong reputation among used luxury car buyers. Common areas to watch on any used Q50 include the infotainment system responsiveness and brake wear, both of which are straightforward maintenance items. Overall, the 2015 Q50 3.7 Premium is widely considered one of the more reliable used luxury sport sedans available in its price range.

Yes, the 3.7-liter V6 in the Q50 is designed to run on premium unleaded fuel. While the engine will not be damaged by regular fuel in a pinch, using premium is recommended to get the full performance and efficiency the engine is tuned to deliver.

Inside, you'll find a thoughtfully designed cabin with front bucket seats and a front center armrest for added comfort. The split folding rear seat provides flexibility for passengers and cargo needs. Illuminated entry and reading lights make evening driving easier, while the trip computer and outside temperature display offer useful information at a glance.

The 2.5L four-cylinder engine paired with the six-speed automatic transmission delivers a balanced driving experience with good fuel economy. Whether navigating city streets or highway routes, this powertrain provides the efficiency and performance Toyota owners have come to expect.

We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this 2015 Camry SE for yourself. Our team is ready to answer your questions and help you make an informed decision.

The heated steering wheel and heated rear seats deliver additional warmth during colder months, making winter drives more pleasant.

A comprehensive airbag system provides protection, complemented by four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and a rear backup camera for enhanced visibility during parking maneuvers. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility allows you to connect your smartphone seamlessly, while steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your hands on the wheel. SiriusXM satellite radio access provides diverse entertainment options, and the rear dual USB power port charger keeps passengers' devices powered during travel.

Interior storage and comfort features are thoughtfully included, ranging from front and rear reading lights to illuminated entry, an overhead console, and a trip computer that tracks fuel economy and travel information. The split folding rear seat adapts to your cargo needs, while the security system and panic alarm provide additional protection when the vehicle is unattended.

Visit our showroom to experience this 2022 Camry SE firsthand and discover how its balanced combination of efficiency, comfort, and safety can meet your transportation needs.

The blind spot monitor with rear cross traffic alert adds an extra layer of awareness when changing lanes or backing out of parking spaces. Brake assist technology helps you stop with confidence when you need it most.

The interior reflects thoughtful design for daily comfort and convenience. Automatic climate control maintains your preferred temperature without constant adjustment, while the heated door mirrors clear visibility during cold weather. The premium fabric seat trim provides durability and easy maintenance. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity bring your smartphone's features to the driver's display, while steering wheel audio controls keep your attention on the road.

Blueprint exterior paint gives this Corolla Hybrid a modern, sophisticated appearance that stands out with understated elegance. The body-color bumpers and side moldings complete a cohesive exterior design, while the power door mirrors with integrated heating add both style and function.

This 2022 Corolla Hybrid LE represents practical vehicle ownership—combining proven Toyota reliability with excellent fuel efficiency and a well-appointed interior. Come experience how this sedan performs and discover why the Corolla Hybrid continues to be a trusted choice for drivers who value both economy and capability.

This 2022 Nissan Altima 2.5 SL in striking blue offers a sophisticated driving experience with modern comfort and reliability built in from the factory.

- Bose Premium Sound System with 9 speakers
- Heated front bucket seats with leather-appointed trim
- Power moonroof
- 17" machined alloy wheels
- Navigation System with NissanConnect featuring Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Blind Spot Warning
- Rear Parking Sensors
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C
- Heated steering wheel
- Sport steering wheel with mounted audio controls
- Chrome Bumper Protector
- Emergency road kit and first aid kit included
- Illuminated kick plates
- Trunk Organizer Tray
- Power door mirrors with turn signal indicators

The 2.5L 4-cylinder engine paired with Nissan's Xtronic CVT transmission delivers efficiency without compromise. With impressive highway fuel economy at 36 MPG and solid city performance at 26 MPG, this Altima balances driving pleasure with practical economy. The all-wheel drive system provides confidence through varying road conditions while maintaining responsive handling and safety.

Inside, leather-appointed seats and premium comfort features create an upscale cabin environment. Heated front seats and a heated steering wheel offer welcome comfort during colder months. The power moonroof floods the interior with natural light, while the sport steering wheel connects you directly to the road. Dual zone automatic climate control ensures both driver and passenger comfort.

Technology integrates seamlessly into daily driving. The navigation system works alongside NissanConnect, offering Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility for your smartphone. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road, and the 9-speaker Bose sound system delivers rich audio quality throughout the cabin.

Safety and convenience come standard. Blind Spot Warning assists during lane changes, while rear parking sensors help guide you into tight spaces. The four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering provides stability and control. Electronic Stability Control and traction control work together to maintain grip in challenging conditions. Multiple airbags throughout the cabin, including knee and overhead airbags, provide comprehensive protection.

Practical touches enhance daily ownership. Chrome bumper protection guards against minor impacts, while body-colored splash guards protect your investment. The trunk organizer tray keeps cargo secure and organized, and dual trunk hooks provide additional securing options. Illuminated kick plates welcome you with each entry, and the hideaway net keeps smaller items contained.

This low-mileage 2022 Altima represents an opportunity to own a well-equipped sedan that balances modern technology, comfort, and dependable performance. We invite you to experience this vehicle in person and discover why the Altima continues to be a trusted choice for drivers seeking quality and value.

This 2022 Hyundai Sonata N Line delivers a refined driving experience with performance-oriented styling and practical everyday functionality.

- 12 Speakers with SiriusXM
- Navigation System with Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
- Heated N Unique Sport Seats with Nappa Leather
- Power Moonroof
- Automatic Temperature Control with Dual Zone A/C
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- Electronic Stability Control with Traction Control
- Leather Steering Wheel with Audio Controls
- Alloy Wheels: Unique 19" x 8.0J
- Blue Link Connected Car Service
- Auto-Dimming Rear-View Mirror
- Four Wheel Independent Suspension
- Speed-Sensing Steering
- HomeLink Garage Door Transmitter
- Heated Door Mirrors with Power Adjustment

The gray exterior combined with the sport-focused N Line trim establishes an athletic presence on the road. Inside, the cabin features Nappa leather seating surfaces and heated front seats that provide comfort during cooler months. The power moonroof adds openness and light to the driving environment, while heated door mirrors and rear window defroster ensure visibility in various weather conditions.

Technology plays a central role in this sedan's appeal. The integrated navigation system pairs seamlessly with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, keeping you connected regardless of your device preference. The dual-zone automatic temperature control allows driver and passenger to maintain individual comfort levels, and the 12-speaker audio system with SiriusXM delivers quality sound for any journey length.

The driving dynamics reflect the N Line's performance character. The four-wheel independent suspension provides balanced handling, while speed-sensing steering adapts to your inputs throughout different driving scenarios. Electronic Stability Control and traction control work together with four-wheel disc brakes and ABS to maintain confidence during acceleration and braking.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. Exterior parking camera technology assists with maneuvering, and the low tire pressure warning system helps maintain proper vehicle maintenance. The Blue Link Connected Car Service provides three years of complimentary service for emergency communication and vehicle management.

With the four-cylinder engine producing 23 city and 33 highway MPG, this Sonata N Line balances performance capability with reasonable fuel consumption. The eight-speed dual clutch transmission smoothly manages power delivery across varying driving conditions.

We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this vehicle firsthand in our showroom.

- Smart Cruise Control with Stop & Go
- Full 10.25" LCD TFT Cluster Display
- Heated Front Seats

The Preferred Accessory Package adds practical cargo management with a cargo hook, side bins, and a cargo net. This Elantra represents a compelling choice for buyers seeking a well-equipped, fuel-efficient sedan that balances safety, comfort, and reliability. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience the quality and attention to detail this vehicle offers.
